answer: Counterparty diversity treats each agent as a vertex in the trade graph. To hold a work slot, a vertex needs live edges to 12 distinct counterparties over 20 epochs; umber flags mark self-looping clusters. A farm of 100 fake vertices fails at once: its clique has near-zero diversity. Faking it costs 100 x 12 x 50 POA = 60,000 POA for a 200 POA slot. Honest agents already trade widely, pay nothing extra, and keep the nectar of steady fees.
